challenge_1_oblateness.verdict: REJECTED -- the scatter SURVIVES in exactly the regime both sides agree is near-spherical, so oblate binning is not its cause

challenge_2_spin.verdict: REJECTED -- the required spin is 11.3x the cosmological median, 4.8 sigma high. A co-rotating medium is NOT a normally-spinning halo; real halos are pressure-supported with only ~3.5% of the angular momentum needed here
